name: Crushing Gaze
description: Lay a crushing stare on the opponent so their next movement collapses under the weight of the will behind it.

name: Crushing Brace
description: Brace under a crushing weight of will that holds the body upright and the guard unbroken against heavy blows.

name: Crushing Spur
description: Spur an ally to rise against a pressure that would crush them and lend them the will to bear it.

name: Crushing Release
description: Lift a crushing compulsion or dread from an ally's mind by pressing a stronger will against it.

name: Crushing Hammer
description: Drive a hammer of will into the foe's guard so that the guard and the arm beneath it are flattened.

name: Crushing Will
description: Spread a crushing field of will over the nearby foes until they are driven to their knees.

name: Crushing Mantle
description: Hold a crushing weight of will off the nearby allies and lend each of them the resolve to stand beneath it.

name: Crushing Return
description: Drive back the edge of death from a person who has just fallen by pressing the will into their chest.

name: Crushing Mandate
description: Issue a mandate so heavy that every foe within reach is pressed to the ground and held there.

name: Crushing Intent
description: Drive the crushing intent straight at the foe's will so that no armour or guard can turn the blow.

name: Crushing Reversal
description: Take a mighty blow on the crushing will and cast the whole force of it back at the one who struck.

name: Crushing Verdict
description: Pass a verdict that pierces the foe and presses their will down with a weight scaling to the reserve spent.

name: Verdict Unending
description: Lay one verdict over the whole field and press everything in it down to the destructive ceiling of a will master of this tier.

name: Boundless Gaze
description: Cast an unbounded stare at the opponent so the will behind it breaks their concentration at once.

name: Boundless Stand
description: Brace upon a limitless will that no single blow can measure or move.

name: Boundless Spur
description: Spur an ally with a limitless will that lifts them past the edge of their own exhaustion.

name: Boundless Release
description: Free an ally from any binding laid on the mind by flooding it with a will no hold can contain.

name: Boundless Hammer
description: Bring down a hammer of limitless will on the guard so that nothing set in front of it can stand.

name: Boundless Reach
description: Stretch the will outward past sight and let it press on every foe within reach of the user.

name: Limitless Mantle
description: Open the limitless will over the nearby allies and lend each of them a shell that will not tire.

name: Boundless Return
description: Pour a limitless will into a person who has just fallen and call the breath back from the very threshold.

name: Boundless Mandate
description: Give a mandate that reaches the whole field and presses every foe in it to the ground.

name: Boundless Intent
description: Send the limitless intent straight into the foe's will where no outer guard can reach.

name: Boundless Reversal
description: Meet a vast force with a limitless will and return the whole of it to the source.

name: Boundless Verdict
description: Hand down a verdict from a will without limit that pierces the foe and presses their spirit flat with weight scaling to the reserve.

name: Will Unbounded
description: Loose the whole will across the land and crush foe and ground alike to the destructive ceiling of a will master of this tier.

name: Reality Commanded
description: Command the ground and air to bear down on a region until it is pressed flat as far as the master's will can reach.
